working_definition: Cyst cells of the adult testis likely associated with spermatocytes; branch a of two branches downstream of early cyst cells (paper Fig. 6G). Authors' term: FBbt:00057004.

best_match.fbbt_definition: A cyst cell which is part of a spermatocyte cyst.

justification: Authors' term FBbt:00057004 is current and a cell term; the label names spermatocyte cyst cell, with the branch designation not captured by FBbt. No adult variant exists.
recommendation: Keep authors' term spermatocyte cyst cell, exact.
